upstream.scope: cards/recipes/*.md only, excluding English translations and gallery duplicates
upstream.notClaimed: No latest-remote claim: this audits the checked-out commit only.

summary.notNativeSlidevCoverage: This is an upstream inventory, not evidence that any recipe has been faithfully ported or visually validated.

method.fingerprints: SHA-256 of file bytes; all local source imports recursively resolved. Type-only imports are included. Runtime routing wrapper is recorded in composition declaration, not expanded into every unrelated template.
method.assets: Literal static asset references in primary-source closure and sample JSON, resolved against cards/public and referencing file directory. Computed or arbitrary user-supplied paths may require additional runtime checks; no license inferred merely from file presence.
method.uniqueness: 137 primary source paths, not 139 independently implemented animations. Byte fingerprints and shared source groups are verifiable; no claim all other files are algorithmically or visually distinct.
method.validation: Source and metadata audit only; no rendered-frame fidelity assertion.

licenseAudit.code: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 HKUST Dial Lab and DataMagic contributors. Preserve copyright and permission notices.
licenseAudit.flags: lipis/flag-icons MIT with separate 2013 Panayiotis Lipiridis copyright notice.
licenseAudit.brandMarks: Simple Icons CC0-1.0; trademark rights remain with owners.
licenseAudit.originalCategoryCoffeeRegionIcons: Explicitly inherit DataMagic project license in respective README files.
licenseAudit.notoSansSC: Bundled SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice present in cards/gallery/fonts; retain it with redistributed fonts.
licenseAudit.inter: Package-lock records @fontsource/inter 5.3.0 as OFL-1.1. Retain actual font license from installed distribution; no standalone Inter license found in checked cards tree.
licenseAudit.remotion: Separate Remotion licensing applies; README explicitly says to check its terms. MIT project license does not replace dependency licenses.
licenseAudit.maps: README declares Natural Earth public geographic data. Verify map data origin when redistributing extracted geometry.
licenseAudit.generatedMedia: README identifies fictional presenter and industrial media as generated; cat-host README documents AI-generated fictional character provenance. No asset-specific license grant/rights-clearance proof for every generated image/video found; do not assert universal MIT media clearance.

renderingFidelityAudit.fontRequirements: Load Inter 400/600/700 and Noto Sans SC 400/700. stableFonts registers complete local CJK faces through document.fonts and waits before rendering. Await equivalent document.fonts readiness before comparison/export.
renderingFidelityAudit.canvasRequirements: Use original composition width/height and frame/fps, scale a fixed-size canvas uniformly. Preserve overflow, transform origin and absolute positions.
renderingFidelityAudit.cssIsolation: Upstream entry imports no authored global reset stylesheet. Slidev/Tailwind reset can alter h1/p margins, line-height, box-sizing, SVG dimensions, buttons and images. Shadow DOM isolates selectors but inherits host font/line-height/color and CSS custom properties; set those deliberately. Do not insert a blanket reset without verifying the actual Remotion render baseline.
renderingFidelityAudit.unverified: Remotion Studio/player internal global CSS not available in local installed dependencies during this audit; exact injected reset has not been established. Needs installed-package inspection or computed-style comparison before claiming pixel parity.
renderingFidelityAudit.media: Preserve crop/objectFit, mute, freeze/last-frame-hold and single-clock timing; replacing OffthreadVideo with a browser video element requires deterministic seeking/frame validation.

replacementAssets.purpose: Replace seven upstream assets with insufficient asset-specific provenance. These original SVGs intentionally differ visually and are not fidelity-equivalent.

replacementAssets.license: Original SVG geometry authored for this adaptation; no third-party images, fonts, logos or external references embedded. Reuse under the adaptation project license.
